format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(bayesrules)
library(here)
library(tidymodels)
library(textrecipes)
library(e1071) # Naive Bayes implementation
library(shiny)

```

```{r}
email_data <- read_csv(here("final_projects/email_classification.csv"))
```

```{r}
combined_data <- read_csv(here("final_projects/combined_data.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Preprocess data
email_data <- email_data %>%
  mutate(label = as.factor(label)) # Ensure label is a factor

# Create a recipe for text preprocessing
# Preprocess data: Define and prep the recipe once
email_recipe <- recipe(label ~ email, data = email_data) %>%
  step_tokenize(email) %>%
  step_stopwords(email) %>%
  step_tokenfilter(email, max_tokens = 100) %>%
  step_tfidf(email) %>%
  prep() # Prepping the recipe once outside reactive logic

# Prepare data
prepped_data <- email_recipe %>%
  prep() %>%
  bake(new_data = NULL)

# Train a Naive Bayes model
nb_model <- naiveBayes(label ~ ., data = prepped_data)

# Save the model
saveRDS(nb_model, "naive_bayes_model.rds")
```

```{r}
# Load pre-trained model
nb_model <- readRDS("naive_bayes_model.rds")



# Define UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Spam Detection using Bayesian Analysis"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      textAreaInput("email_input", "Enter Email Content:", "", rows = 6),
      actionButton("predict", "Predict")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      textOutput("result"),
      plotOutput("prob_plot")
    )
  )
)

# Define server logic
server <- function(input, output) {
  observeEvent(input$predict, {
    # Preprocess user input
    user_email <- tibble(email = input$email_input)
    prepped_email <- bake(email_recipe, new_data = user_email)
    
    # Simulate slight variations to generate a distribution
    simulated_probs <- replicate(100, {
      # Perturb features slightly (simulate noise)
      noisy_email <- prepped_email + rnorm(n = ncol(prepped_email), mean = 0, sd = 0.01)
      noisy_email[noisy_email < 0] <- 0  # Keep valid feature values
      predict(nb_model, noisy_email, type = "raw")[1, "spam"]
    })
    
    # Display median prediction
    output$result <- renderText({
      paste("Median Prediction Probability for Spam:", round(median(simulated_probs), 3))
    })
    
    # Plot distribution of probabilities
    output$prob_plot <- renderPlot({
      ggplot(data = tibble(probability = simulated_probs), aes(x = probability)) +
        geom_density(fill = "pink", alpha = 0.6) +
        labs(title = "Distribution of Predicted Probability of Spam",
             x = "Probability of Spam", y = "Density") +
        theme_minimal()
    })
  })
}

# Run the app
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```
